Compensate farmer [[Old Mac]], the owner of [[Rogue Bull|Bill the bull]], for killing him for [[Lady Althea]] during [[A Mesmer's Burden]] by finding a [[devourer egg]] for him.

== Quest information ==

=== Requirements ===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| test = n
| campaign = pre
}}
* Having killed the rogue bull during A Mesmer's Burden without abandoning said [[quest]].

=== Objectives ===
* Search for a source of devourer eggs in [[Lakeside County]]. Collect one devourer egg.
* Return to Old Mac for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 250 [[Experience]]
* 25 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)
* [[Jeweled Staff (metal)|Jeweled Staff]]
** [[Energy]] +3
** [[Chaos Dmg]]: 3-5
** Damage +10% (vs. [[Hexed]] foes)
** [[Health]] +5 (while Hexed)
** Two-handed

===Environmental changes===
* Upon accepting the quest, Old Mac will no longer walk up to Althea's stage to have a [[Lakeside County#Lady Althea and Old Mac|short argument]] with her.

== Walkthrough ==
This quest becomes available after killing the Rogue Bull as part of A Mesmer's Burden. It turns out that the bull (named 'Bill'), was owned by Old Mac. After rezoning and approaching the [[Ascalon City (outpost)|Ascalon City]] gate, Old Mac will appear near the [[resurrection shrine]] on the left. He will walk up to Lady Althea by [[Althea's Actors Stage|her stage]] and have a short conversation with her. He will then walk back the way he came and stand just outside the entrance to Ascalon City; he will give the quest at any time after talking to Althea.

The best source of eggs is [[Duke Gaban]]'s quest, [[The Egg Hunter]], across the river from Ascalon City, at the [[Devourer Cave]]. You can also trade 5 [[Skale Fin]]s to [[Brownlow]] just outside the entrance to Ascalon City, or 3 [[Dull Carapace]]s to [[Rownan]] in [[Regent Valley]] for an egg.

Once you have acquired an egg, return it to Old Mac to get your reward.

== Dialogue ==

=== Initial dialogue ===
; Old Mac
: ''"You! You're the one who killed my bull, Bill! 'Twas at Althea's bidding, sure, but that's naught to me. If you and that Althea woman won't compensate me, I'll take my case to the constabulary, and I'll get satisfaction. That bull protected my farm for all these years. Who will protect it now? Hmm… You know what might do the trick? A devourer might, if I could raise it from a hatchling and train it myself. Tell you what: you bring me a '''Devourer egg''', {{sic|devourer egg}} and we'll call it even. What do you say?"''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = You've got a deal.
| decline = Your threats don't scare me.
| ask = Just bring me one '''devourer egg''', and all will be forgiven. I'd give it to you in writing, if I had a scrap of paper to my name.
}}

=== Reward dialogue ===
; Old Mac
: ''"Ah, that's lovely! A devourer all my own. I think I'll call him Joe. Come Joe, let's get you someplace warm and dry. Shhh… There's a good egg."''

== Notes ==

{{anomaly|While Old Mac is talking to Lady Althea (before he gives the quest) he answers Althea a few moments before she says anything.}}
